sql:
SELECT sc."CharterNum", AVG(s.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_write_score
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND sc."CharterNum" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY sc."CharterNum"
ORDER BY avg_write_score DESC
